note: Use for every slice_part call on this project unless the user overrides. v3 replaces v2 (backup: scratch/print_archive_v2_2026-11-09/ holds the v2 defaults and G-code). Trial-sliced with PrusaSlicer 2.9.6; NOT yet print-tested - print the temp tower first, report real results back and tune. The slice_part block is the exact call (args + overrides + per-plate rows) that produced the current G-code; pass it as-is.
filament_preset: Generic PLA @CREALITY (filament on the printer: Elegoo PLA+, rated 205-230 C)

slice_part.how: Call slice_part(parts=[{path, orientation:'as_is'}...], name='<HH>h<MM>m_<plate>', output_dir=<TBOT>/print/creality_ender_3_0_4_mm_nozzle, **args, walls/infill_percent from the plate row, complete_individual_objects from the plate row, overrides={**overrides, 'support_material_threshold': str(plate threshold)}). Meshes are oriented per orientations_build_up; the v3 slices used the placed meshes in scratch/print_archive_v2_2026-11-09/.<v2 plate>.slice/.

changes_from_v2.why: v2 prints: heavy stringing/hair, surface zits, bad seams (photo predates the nozzle swap and 215->210). Retraction (5 mm @ 60 mm/s, wipe on) and part fan (100% from layer 3) were already correct; the causes below were v2 overrides fighting a Bowden Ender-3 with no Linear Advance.
changes_from_v2.z_hop: retract_lift 0.2 -> 0. The Creality vendor printer preset has retract_lift 0; v2 added a 0.2 mm hop on every retract (1123 Z moves on cover_R alone). Z-hop drags ooze up into strings on a Bowden; v3 cover_R has only the 146 layer-change Z moves.
changes_from_v2.seams: scarf_seam_placement everywhere -> nowhere, seam_gap_distance 5% -> 15%, staggered_inner_seams 0 -> 1; seam_position aligned kept. These are the right defaults for a Bowden Ender with no Linear Advance (scarf ramps need pressure advance to taper cleanly). Caveat: v2 G-code shows filament_seam_gap_distance = 15% (it overrides the print value, so v2's 5% probably never applied) and scarf_seam_only_on_smooth = 1 (scarf may not have fired on these boxy faces), so the v2 seam blobs may have been mostly ooze / PTFE seat / wet filament rather than these settings.
changes_from_v2.plates: Multi-part layer-by-layer plates split to one part per plate (nose_clamps_carrier_L -> nose_clamp_L / nose_clamp_R / carrier_L; covers_L_belly -> cover_L / belly_cover). Every layer of a multi-part plate travels across open air between parts - the biggest string source on a Bowden. small_parts stays one plate because it prints complete-individual-objects (no inter-object travel per layer).
changes_from_v2.temperature: Stays 210 C (first layer 210) - Elegoo PLA+ is rated 205-230 C, so going lower risks weak layers. Use temp_tower_225_to_200.gcode to pick the real number for this spool.

changes_from_v1.supports: ORGANIC on every plate (v1 used snug on multi-object plates). contact distance 0.15 -> 0.2 (one full layer; 0.15 was thinner than the layer and fused supports to the part), xy gap 60% (~0.26 mm) -> 0.45 mm, threshold 55 -> 45 deg (55 over-supported shallow slopes that print fine with 100% fan), dont_support_bridges 0 -> 1 (no supports under bridgeable spans).
changes_from_v1.plate_mode: complete_individual_objects true -> false. Organic branches/brim spill ~12-14 mm past the model bbox, so sequential clearance always failed with organic (58 mm approach vs 70 mm radius). Print multi-part plates layer by layer instead; extruder_clearance_radius override dropped (vendor value). One-part plates are unaffected.
changes_from_v1.seams: scarf length 10 -> 15 mm, max segment 1 -> 0.5 mm (smoother ramp), seam gap 15% -> 5% (scarf tapers, a wide gap left a visible groove), aligned kept.
changes_from_v1.surface: temp 215 -> 210 (first layer stays 215) to cut ooze/hair; fan off only first 2 layers (was 1); volumetric cap 15 -> 10 mm3/s (Ender stock hotend can't melt 15); thick_bridges off (flatter ceilings); extra perimeters on overhangs on; retract_before_travel 3 -> 2, travel 120 -> 150 mm/s (less time oozing on travel).
changes_from_v1.bridging: Bridge-first: dont_support_bridges 1, thick_bridges 1 (reliable long spans; cosmetic cost only on ceilings), bridge speed 25 mm/s @100% fan, bridge flow 0.95, overhang detect on, support threshold 40 deg (was 55) so 40-55 deg slopes are printed, not propped, dynamic overhang speeds 15/20/25/30 mm/s with 100% fan, extra perimeters on overhangs.

if_still_bad: Print temp_tower_225_to_200 first (52 min). Two pillars, six 8 mm bands, 225 C at the bottom, -5 C per band (band edges are visible as a step in pillar diameter). Pick the coolest band with clean walls and good layer bonding, then set nozzle_temp_c to it and re-slice.
Strings/hair on every band of the tower: the filament is wet - dry it (4-6 h at 50 C). Wet PLA+ pops and strings at any temperature.

After a nozzle swap on a stock Creality hotend the PTFE tube must sit hard against the nozzle (hot-tighten the nozzle at ~240 C, re-seat the Bowden into the coupler). A gap there gives blobs, zits and strings at once.
Seam blobs remain: lower extrusion_multiplier to 0.96 (run a flow cube) or try retract_restart_extra -0.1. Seam on a show face: seam_position=rear for that part.
Strings remain after drying and the tower: slice 2-3 small test plates with retract_length 4 / 6 (vendor is 5) and compare.
Supports still hard to pop: raise support_material_contact_distance to 0.25 or support_material_xy_spacing to 0.6.
Underside droop on supported ceilings: support_material_contact_distance back to 0.15 for that part only.
seams: seam_position=aligned, scarf off, seam gap 15%, staggered inner seams, wipe on
stringing: 210 C, retract 5 mm @60 mm/s (Ender preset), wipe, retract_before_travel 2, NO z-hop, avoid_crossing_perimeters (detour 5), travel 150 mm/s, one part per layer-by-layer plate
naming: <HH>h<MM>m_<plate>  (slice once to get the time, then re-slice with name=; slice_part strips '.' from names so do not use decimals)
plate_rules: One part per plate unless the plate prints complete-individual-objects (then the Ender-3 25 mm clearance-height rule applies: at most one object taller, printed last). Pack whole parts only; never split a part across plates.

known_issues.cover_L: CAD export_failed 'STL facet collapses' (sub-micron slivers at X522.4,Y25.8). Sliced from scratch/slice_trials/cover_L_clean.stl (vertices snapped to 1e-3 mm). Re-clean after any cover_L edit.
known_issues.trigger_set: floating_extrusion fail is anchored bridge infill (no hard unanchored run); bracket servo-pocket ceilings. Pre-existing geometry.

no_brim_no_elephant_foot: User rule 2026-11-08: NO brim (slice_part brim=0, skirts 0) and no elephant's foot (elefant_foot_compensation 0.2 mm, up from 0.15) so parts are dimensionally accurate. Verified: trial G-codes contain no Skirt/Brim extrusion. Not print-tested; if first layer still flares, drop bed_temp_c to 55 and raise compensation to 0.25. If tall/slender parts lift without a brim, fix orientation/bed adhesion (clean bed, level) rather than adding a brim.

bridging_trials_2026-11-08.method: same STLs, brim 0, organic; baseline = thick_bridges 0 / threshold 45 / no dynamic overhang speeds
bridging_trials_2026-11-08.note: Threshold 35 also cleared the trigger-set floating_extrusion fail but prints 55 deg overhangs unsupported; use per-part only if surface droop is acceptable. Not print-tested.

support_threshold_findings_2026-11-08.why: PrusaSlicer organic supports fill circular holes whose crown is shallower than the threshold. Lowering support_material_threshold stops it, but parts with big flat ceilings (covers) then print 90-130 mm of unsupported air (floating_extrusion fail at threshold <=20, clean at 30). So threshold is per plate.

per_part.trig_clamp_R_v2: 5 (0 mm support in holes; 10.9 mm bridge over the D10.4 counterbore crown flagged vs limit 10)
per_part.nose_clamp_L/R, carrier_L: 10 (5 gives a 34.6 mm unanchored run on the nose clamps)
per_part.carrier_R: 10 (thr 5: 4 holes / 733 mm; thr 10: 5 holes / 1039 mm but smaller floating run; thr 40: 13 holes / 3092 mm)

support_threshold_findings_2026-11-08.tool: scratch/hole_support_check.py <placed .slice stl> <gcode>  - counts support extrusion inside fitted circular bores
support_threshold_findings_2026-11-08.limit: organic supports ignore dont_support_bridges for some shallow recess ceilings; remaining support in holes is listed in plates_v3.hole_support_mm. Only a teardrop/chamfered crown in CAD removes it fully.

orientation_review_2026-11-08: Scored all 6 axis build directions per part (scratch/orient_score.py: overhang area, bed contact, bore axes vertical vs horizontal). Existing orientations (orientations_build_up) are the best compromise for support AND strength on every part: plates/covers lie flat (loads in layer plane), carriers +X and trig clamp +Z keep most insert bores horizontal. Nose clamps stay flank-down: +-Z puts all bores horizontal but needs 15-25x the support inside the barrel bore.

temp_tower.how: slice_part overrides layer_gcode with an {if layer_z < ...}M104 chain
